name: Raydium
description: Solana's largest AMM and liquidity protocol. Provides direct smart contract interaction for swaps, liquidity provisioning, and concentrated liquidity pools. Use when the application needs direct AMM integration beyond swap aggregation — Jupiter routes through Raydium pools but Raydium SDK enables direct pool interaction for liquidity management.

ecosystem_fit.notes: One of the two largest Solana DEXs by TVL and volume. Direct integration is required for liquidity provisioning, pool creation, and concentrated liquidity management.

common_pairings.context: Jupiter aggregates Raydium pools for optimal swap routing — use Jupiter when swap price is the goal. Use Raydium SDK directly when managing liquidity positions or building directly on top of Raydium pools.
Helius RPC for Solana transaction submission; Raydium SDK for AMM interaction construction.
Jito MEV bundles for submitting Raydium transactions with MEV protection and priority fee optimization.

trust_evidence.description: Raydium is the largest Solana AMM by TVL. Core infrastructure of the Solana DeFi ecosystem with deep integration by trading bots and LP managers.
Raydium SDK v2 documentation covers pool interactions, liquidity management, and swap construction.

scale_guidance.hackathon: Use Jupiter instead — swap aggregation covers Raydium pools without the SDK overhead.
scale_guidance.mvp: Use Raydium SDK directly only if liquidity provisioning is a core product feature. For swap-only, Jupiter is simpler.
scale_guidance.production: Required for any product that manages liquidity positions on Raydium CLMM pools. Ensure SDK version matches on-chain program version.

alternatives.when_to_prefer: When the goal is optimal swap execution. Jupiter aggregates Raydium and other DEXs for best price. Use Raydium SDK directly only when direct pool interaction is required.

anti_patterns: Using Raydium SDK for simple token swaps when Jupiter gives better prices via aggregation.
Assuming Raydium SDK v1 and v2 are compatible — v2 is a breaking rewrite. Check SDK version matches the on-chain program you're interacting with.
Using Raydium for EVM chains — Raydium is Solana-only.
